summary: Tracks which KIND of device was used most recently, and fires when it changes.
overview: Reports keyboard-and-mouse versus gamepad — not a specific device. This is what the glyph swapper reads to decide which icon to show, and the swap happens the instant the player touches the other device.
The actual per-frame polling lives in a separate runner component rather than in this static tracker, so the tracker needs no scene object of its own.
useCases: Driving every prompt icon in the game from one source.
Hiding a mouse cursor when a gamepad is picked up.
Switching UI navigation behaviour by input kind.

gotchas.title: It reports the last used, not the connected
gotchas.body: A connected but untouched gamepad does not change the answer, which is what you want — the icons follow the player's hands, not the hardware.
